subject: Approval request: payband addendum + equity top-up for candidate Evan Parker
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rebecca (Catalyst) <rebecca@catalysttalent.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approval needed: comp addendum for Evan Parker (Data Infra)

Hi Lauren / Marissa / Vivek —

We have an excellent final-stage candidate for the Data Infrastructure lead role, Evan Parker (ref attached). Offer needs an exception to the posted payband to land him. Summary: he’s asking for $12k higher base than the max of the band (~+15% over midpoint), a one-time RSU top-up of $60,000 (4-year vest, standard cliff), and a sign-on of $15,000 to cover relocation/compression. Recruiter says 2 competing offers on the table.

Rationale in the attached comp case: Evan has deep production infra + on-call experience (ran a 40-person infra org at his last company), immediate impact on our latency goals, and critical Redis/MSK expertise that is rare. Hiring manager (me) is recommending exception because ramp time is short and this fills a strategic gap.

Asks:
- Approve out-of-band base increase to $165,000 (one-time exception)
- Approve RSU top-up $60,000 grant
- Approve sign-on $15,000

If we can get approvals today we can get him to sign tomorrow and meet the candidate’s window. Attaching: proposed_offer_evan_20260714.pdf and comp_case_ev_20260714.xlsx.

Thanks — I’m standing by on Slack if you want to discuss live.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rebecca (Catalyst) <rebecca@catalysttalent.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval needed: comp addendum for Evan Parker (Data Infra)

Thanks Aditya — quick thoughts: I’m comfortable with a sign-on and the RSU top-up given comp sensitivity for infra leaders. I’m cautious about fully exceeding the band on base by 15% without a deeper budget/bench check.

Conditional approval:
- RSU top-up $60k: APPROVED
- Sign-on $15k: APPROVED
- Base increase: APPROVE up to +10% only (please re-run comp ledger and show net budget impact vs. hiring plan).

Vivek — can you confirm we have headcount and runway to absorb the remainder of base delta if the hiring manager wants full +15%? Marissa / People Ops, please confirm final grant sizing mechanics if approved.

Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Director, Engineering (Data & Infrastructure)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval needed: comp addendum for Evan Parker (Data Infra)

Thanks — I reviewed the headcount plan and reallocated budget from an open backend hire slated for Q4. We can cover up to +15% on base for this fiscal year if we mark the backend hire as deferred and record the variance against SLC hiring flexibility. Approving the full package (base +15%, $60k RSU, $15k sign-on) on the condition that recruiting updates HR-827 and we track spend to the Data Infra hiring line item.

Link to headcount ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HR-827

Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform Engineering
From: Rebecca (Catalyst) <rebecca@catalysttalent.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:09:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate timeline: Evan Parker — needs final by 7/15 EOD

Hi team — quick note from Evan and his family. They’ve received a counter from another firm and have asked for a firm written offer by end of day 7/15 to consider Redwood first. Evan is willing to accept immediately if the outlined package is offered (full base +15%, $60k RSU top-up, $15k sign-on).

He asked I flag that timing is tight — if you can send the updated offer today we’ll request his formal acceptance and an intent-to-sign note.

Best,
Rebecca
Catalyst Talent (external recruiter)
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evan Parker <evan.parker@gmail.com>, Rebecca (Catalyst) <rebecca@catalysttalent.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Finalized: offer sent to Evan Parker — candidate accepted verbally

Folks —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Vivek’s reallocation and Lauren/Marissa approvals, I updated the offer to reflect full approvals: base at +15% over band, $60k RSU top-up, and $15k sign-on. I attached the signed offer packet we sent (signed_offer_ev_20260715.pdf) — Evan accepted verbally this morning and provided a target start of 2026-09-02.

Next steps:
- Marissa: please confirm grant paperwork and open headcount ticket update (HR-827 updated)
- Vivek: I’ll send a short note to finance to flag the reallocation
- Recruiting: begin onboarding checklist and relocation coordination with Evan + family

Attaching final packet.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
